name: Groom
summary: The groom attends to the needs of the party’s mounts and beasts of burden during their adventures, and guards these animals while the party goes underground.

features.name: Hide the Horses (Ex)
features.summary: A groom finds the best place to stable and conceal a party’s mounts while the group explores a dungeon. A groom adds half her level (minimum 1) on Stealth skill checks for both herself and the mounts she’s hiding while she is concealing a party’s mounts. This ability replaces track.

features.name: Horse Whisperer (Su)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a groom can use speak with animals at will, but can use this power only on horses, riding dogs, and other mounts of the animal type. This ability replaces Endurance.

resourceActions.label: Speak with animal mount

confirmations.label: The target is a horse, riding dog, or other mount of the animal type

resourceActions.summary: Use speak with animals at will, limited to animal mounts.

features.name: Scout the Area (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a groom gains a +4 bonus on Knowledge (local) checks. In addition, she always knows where to find the nearest expert or spellcaster who can provide a particular service, such as the nearest source of raise dead . This ability replaces the ranger’s 1st favored terrain.

mechanicalNotes: Horse Whisperer is exposed as an at-will speak with animals action restricted to animal mounts, and Scout the Area applies its +4 Knowledge (local) bonus. Hide the Horses' shared half-level Stealth bonus for both the ranger and concealed mounts remains manual until companion and party-mount skill checks share one tracked effect.
